`vad-speech-8k.raw` is the 8 kHz mono signed 16-bit PCM `test-audio.raw`
fixture from https://github.com/wiseman/py-webrtcvad (downloaded 2026-09-05).
Its upstream test checks speech detection against known voiced frames.
The upstream license is preserved in `vad-speech-LICENSE.txt`.
This is public test audio, not a recording of the user's calls.
